name: Ormak Grimshot
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Ormak Grimshot teaches hunters to face the wilds. With Grimfang beside him, he trains Horde hunters to track, shoot, and tame beasts.

sections.title: Master of the Hunt
sections.body: In the Hunter's Hall, Ormak Grimshot trains Horde trackers and marksmen. Grimfang, his wolf, stays at his side as he teaches hunters to survive Kalimdor's wilderness. Orc and troll hunters who have completed their trials in Durotar learn from him to tame and command wild beasts, then form lasting bonds with their animal companions.

faq.answer: Ormak Grimshot trains Horde hunters in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He teaches ranged combat and how to master beasts.

faq.q: Where can I find Ormak Grimshot?
faq.answer: Ormak Grimshot is inside the Hunter's Hall in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. His wolf, Grimfang, is near him.

faq.q: Who is the wolf beside him?
faq.answer: The wolf beside Ormak Grimshot is Grimfang, his loyal companion. Their bond shows how a hunter and an animal companion work together.

faq.q: What role does he play for new hunters?
faq.answer: Ormak Grimshot teaches novice orc and troll hunters to train, feed, and manage beasts they have tamed after their basic trials in Durotar.

angles.text: As a Horde hunter, you can learn from Ormak Grimshot how to tame and care for a loyal animal companion.
As an orc, you can look to Ormak Grimshot's partnership with Grimfang as an example of working alongside wolves and native predators to defend Durotar.
